description:
Enable and configure photosensor-based daylighting controls for the 2nd-floor perimeter zones of the 4StoreyBuilding commercial office model. 

1. Navigate to the Building Shell module and locate the four perimeter spaces on the 2nd Floor (South, East, North, West).
2. For EACH of these four spaces, enable Daylighting.
3. Configure the following control parameters for all four spaces:
   - Control Type: Continuous Dimming ('CONTINUOUS')
   - Illuminance Setpoint: 50 fc
   - Minimum Power Fraction: 0.30
   - Minimum Light Fraction: 0.20

4. Run the annual energy simulation to quantify the savings.
5. Save the project.
